sloka: यथा महद्भिर्हरिभिर्बहुभिश्च वनौकसाम् ।सार्धमागच्छ भद्रं ते ह्यनुभोक्तुं महोत्सवम् ।। ७.९१.१० ॥
transliteration: yathā mahadbhirharibhirbahubhiśca vanaukasām ।sārdhamāgaccha bhadraṁ te hyanubhoktuṁ mahotsavam ।। 7.91.10 ॥

translations.english: Come with many great forest-dwelling monkeys to indeed enjoy this great festival, and may you be well.
